Apart from that, despite getting reported nearly every single game by people who didnt like my picks, I not even once got a penalty. So I have to say the overwatch thing is working perfectly fine.

The comm score on the other hand is a retarded piece of ♥♥♥♥, but comm score doesnt get you into low prio.
